reviews.comment:
Muy rica la comida..pero alrrededor muy descuidado dan mal aspecto los fondos de la cocina...el baño de damas ya que soy concurrente frecuente..pileta rota hace años..canillas que gotean..botella de gaseosa con jabon...me gustaria mucho que lo modifiquen...

(Translated by Google)
The food was delicious, but the surrounding area is very neglected; the kitchen backsplash gives a bad impression. The women's restroom, which I frequent, has a broken sink that's been there for years, dripping faucets, and a soapy soda bottle. I would really appreciate it if they would fix it.
